text_read: digest only; section 3.5 (nothing felt at all) shown only by its last lines, and Ch. 5/7 aura seeing and Ch. 10 troubleshooting only in fragments
mode_evidence: Insists on 'no imagination, no visualisation – just awareness of what is in front of you' and calls the light 'spiritual light, perceived with your eyes closed', not physical light; it ranges from haze to colours, shining dots and patterns. Open-eye work: room appears darker, 'astral light' seen, paths glow at night. The source's own metaphysics (etheric/astral) frames it, but the instruction is perceptual.
onset_evidence: Staged ladder for those who see nothing: first find any vibration/tingling/pressure between the eyebrows (throat friction plus gentle awareness, 5 to 10 minutes per phase), then in the later phase look there for any fog, haze or glow and connect it to the throat friction. Says most who think they cannot see light see it but do not recognise it, faint whitish haze counts. Claims no student at his school failed to feel the vibration after a bit of practice, and urges persistence. Intensity varies day to day. No grace or transmission requirement stated in the digest; one should not grasp or concentrate. Suggested 5 to 10 minutes each morning plus constant background awareness.

what_to_do_with_light: connect throat friction to it to amplify it, drop the hazier parts and attend to the brightest; then rest awareness in the background space; do not label hues too readily
obstacles_and_fixes: grasping or concentrating blocks the process: stay vacant
sensation elsewhere in the face: ignore and stay between the eyebrows
faint or blurry light: accept as first thread and keep practising
thoughts: do not fight, return to the eye or intensify throat friction
cautions: do not attach meaning to minor tingling and flashes
keep the practice relative; psychic protection treated in a separate chapter
interpretation: Light between the eyebrows indicates activation of the astral layer of the third eye; the purple space is the astral space. A teacher-manual metaphysics.
practice_summary: Lie down or sit with a vertical spine, eyes closed, and breathe with a soft friction sound in the throat. Move awareness to the area between the eyebrows without grasping or turning the eyeballs there. Look for any vibration, tingling or pressure and join it to the throat friction for several minutes. Then drop the vibration and look in front of the brow for a fog, haze, glow or colour, however faint, and connect the friction to it so it grows brighter; attend to the brightest part, often tiny drifting particles. Finally rest in the dark or purple background as a space. Use no imagination or visualisation. Faint whitish haze is the right beginning. Practise 5 minutes per phase, and every morning, and keep a light awareness between the eyebrows through the day.
